question:
Which of the following statement is correct?

I. If {K}+(1)/({~K)}=12, then {K}²+(1)/({~K)²}=142

II. The value of ({k}²+(1)/({k)²})({k}-(1)/({k)})({k}⁴+(1)/({k)⁴})({k}+(1)/({k)}) is

{k}¹⁶-(1)/({k)¹⁶}
solution:
Given:

k + 1/k = 12

Formula used:

(x + 1/x)2 = (x2 + 1/x2) + 2

(a - b)(a + b) = a² - b²

**Calculation:**

Take first statement

k + 1/k = 12

using 

(x + 1/x)2 = (x2 + 1/x2) + 2

(k2 + 1/k2) = 144 - 2

(k2 + 1/k2) = =142

So, the first statement is true.

Take second statement

({k}²+(1)/({k)²})({k}-(1)/({k)})({k}⁴+(1)/({k)⁴})({k}+(1)/({k)}) 

Using (a - b)(a + b) = a2 - b²

({k}²+(1)/({k)²})({k²}-(1)/({k²)})({k}⁴+(1)/({k)⁴})

({k⁴}-(1)/({k⁴)})({k}⁴+(1)/({k)⁴}) 

{k}⁸-(1)/({k)⁸}

So, the second statement is not true.

Therefore only statement I is true.

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.
